title: 西班牙法国山火肆虐 旅游旺季遭双重打击
speaker: Bloomberg

segments.en: Spain and France are racing to contain wildfires with temperatures soaring again this week.
segments.zh: 西班牙和法国正争分夺秒控制野火，本周气温再次飙升。

segments.en: Here in Nawa-Lunga, Avila, firefighters are monitoring a fire that has passed through more than 50,000 hectares.
segments.zh: 在阿维拉的纳瓦伦加，消防员正在监控一场已蔓延超5万公顷的大火。

segments.en: Last night was the first in a week where the fire didn't advance further.
segments.zh: 昨晚是这一周以来火势首次未进一步蔓延。

segments.en: Excellently high temperatures in the region are further straining emergency services.
segments.zh: 该地区异常高温进一步加剧了应急服务的压力。

segments.en: Spain and France have been at the epicenter of Europe's wildfire season, which has already burned more than 423,000 hectares.
segments.zh: 西班牙和法国是欧洲野火季的中心，已烧毁超42.3万公顷土地。

segments.en: Businesses, homes and farms have all been impacted with the question of rebuilding already looming.
segments.zh: 企业、住宅和农场均受影响，重建问题已迫在眉睫。

segments.en: As the damage costs rise, the fires are also driving away tourists at the height of the holiday season.
segments.zh: 随着损失成本上升，火灾也在旅游旺季驱离游客。

segments.en: A double blow for regions of France and Spain heavily reliant on the summer trade.
segments.zh: 这对依赖夏季旅游的法国和西班牙地区是双重打击。

segments.en: Both countries are drawing up plans to pump money into the affected areas.
segments.zh: 两国正制定计划向受灾地区注入资金。

segments.en: Spain's government said they would be declared emergency zones, opening the door to financial aid.
segments.zh: 西班牙政府表示将宣布这些地区为紧急区域，从而开放财政援助。

segments.en: France's finance minister said interest would cover relocation costs for more than 200,000 people in order to evacuate, even if there is no damage to their homes.
segments.zh: 法国财长表示，利息将覆盖超过20万人的搬迁费用，即使他们的房屋未受损，也要进行疏散。
